page.title: Settings
page.subtitle: Choose how Income Guardian looks and which language it speaks. Changes are saved to your account and follow you to any device.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: All three themes keep green for what matters; they change the background and contrast.
theme.forest: Deep, calm green. Made for everyday use.
theme.paper: Light and warm. Comfortable for reading long reports.
theme.noir: High-contrast black. Ideal for focusing on the numbers.

language.title: Language
language.description: Applies to the whole app and to the messages the server sends you.

errors.USER_THEME_INVALID: That theme is not available. Pick one from the list.
errors.USER_LANGUAGE_INVALID: That language is not available. Pick one from the list.
